items.source: The amount of time between HTTP requests should be relatively brief and will not exceed the allows disconnect delay (see AbstractSockJsService.setDisconnectDelay(long)), 5 seconds by default.
items.translation: HTTP 请求之间的时间间隔应相对较短，且不得超过允许的断开连接延迟（参见AbstractSockJsService.setDisconnectDelay(long)），默认值为 5 秒。

items.source: Provides transport handling code with access to the SockJsService configuration options they need to have access to. Mainly for internal use.
items.translation: 为传输处理代码提供对它们需要访问的 SockJsService 配置选项的访问权限。主要用于内部使用。

items.source: The codec to use for encoding and decoding SockJS messages.
items.translation: 用于编码和解码 SockJS 消息的编解码器。

items.source: A scheduler instance to use for scheduling heart-beat messages.
items.translation: 用于调度心跳消息的调度器实例。

items.source: IllegalStateException - if no SockJsMessageCodec is available
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果不可用 SockJsMessageCodec

items.source:
The amount of time in milliseconds when the server has not sent any
messages and after which the server should send a heartbeat frame to the
client in order to keep the connection from breaking.
items.translation: 服务器未发送任何消息的毫秒数，在此时间之后，服务器应向客户端发送心跳帧以保持连接不中断。

items.source:
The number of server-to-client messages that a session can cache while waiting for
the next HTTP polling request from the client.
items.translation: 会话在等待客户端的下一个 HTTP 轮询请求时，可以缓存的服务器到客户端消息的数量。

items.source:
Streaming transports save responses on the client side and don't free
memory used by delivered messages.
items.translation: 流式传输传输会在客户端保存响应，并且不会释放已传递消息所使用的内存。
